questions.stem: What is inbreeding and why is it a concern in selective breeding?

options.text: Breeding organisms in artificial conditions like greenhouses
Breeding organisms with different characteristics to increase variation
Breeding closely related organisms, which can increase the chance of genetic disorders
Breeding organisms from different species, which creates stronger offspring

questions.explanation: Inbreeding means breeding closely related organisms. This reduces genetic diversity and increases the chance that offspring will inherit two copies of harmful recessive alleles, leading to genetic disorders.
